children: Yuga Labs blockchain vice president Quit said on X that a claim portal for stolen NFT incidents under development is expected to go live within the next few hours. According to Odaily, a dedicated nftsaresafu.eth address has also been created to accept ETH and other token donations.

Quit said he has spent a large amount of time on the matter and paid about $7,500 in gas fees last night to handle related issues. He also thanked the community for support through channels including X Money.
Earlier reports said NFT marketplace Magic Eden may have had an NFT security vulnerability, and a white-hat hacker transferred 3,832 NFTs from hundreds of wallets.

title: Yuga Labs Vice President Says NFT Theft Claim Portal Will Launch Within Hours
